description: Statement-level expression evaluation on the SET / session-variable path - unary operators, parentheses and $var references inside a SET expression - plus the SYSTEM$ function family: SYSTEM$STREAM_HAS_DATA reflects pending changes, SYSTEM$USER_TASK_CANCEL_ONGOING_EXECUTIONS reports that nothing is running (echoing the name exactly as passed, accepting a qualified one, and leaving a started task started) while an unknown task is an error, and SYSTEM$TYPEOF answers a type name. Converted 1:1 from features/SessionExpressionAndSystemFuncTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE STREAM shd_stream ON TABLE shd_src
CREATE TASK cancel_me SCHEDULE = '1 MINUTE' AS SELECT 1

expect.value: Task CANCEL_ME has no currently running executions. If the task was dropped or replaced after a previous execution started, use SYSTEM$CANCEL_QUERY along with the query id to cancel the run.

steps.sql: CREATE TASK echo_me SCHEDULE = '1 MINUTE' AS SELECT 1
SELECT STARTSWITH($outcome, 'Task echo_me has no currently running executions.')

error.messageContains: Task NO_SUCH_TASK not found or not authorized.
